security_audit.summary: All 33 static findings are false positives: 27 cite Open Font License text, five cite design instructions, and one mistakes Markdown backticks for execution. Semantic review found a fabricated user statement and an instruction to download fonts from unspecified sources.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md falsely states that the user already demanded a specific quality standard.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the attributed statement with a neutral instruction to perform a final quality review without inventing user intent.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md permits downloading fonts without defining trusted sources, license checks, or integrity controls.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer bundled fonts and require user approval, trusted sources, license verification, and integrity checks before any external font download.

content.user_title: Create Polished Visual Art for PDF and PNG
content.value_statement: Static artwork can lack a coherent visual philosophy and disciplined composition. This skill defines an aesthetic direction, then creates polished PDF or PNG artwork with minimal text.
actual_capabilities: Creates a four-to-six paragraph visual philosophy before producing artwork.
Translates user themes into subtle references expressed through color, form, space, and composition.
Produces single-page PDF or PNG artwork and supports coordinated multi-page variations.
Uses bundled font options to shape typography as part of the visual composition.
Performs a refinement pass focused on spacing, alignment, hierarchy, margins, and overlap prevention.
limitations: Focuses on static PDF and PNG artwork rather than animation, video, or interactive media.
Defaults to one page unless the user requests a multi-page result.
Uses minimal text, so it is not suited to text-heavy reports or detailed documents.
Visual quality depends on available rendering tools, fonts, and the clarity of the source request.

use_cases.title: Develop an art poster
use_cases.description: Turn a theme into an original poster with a defined visual philosophy and a polished single-page composition.

use_cases.title: Create event artwork
use_cases.description: Produce a distinctive venue or cultural event graphic with typography and references suited to the audience.

use_cases.title: Build a visual series
use_cases.description: Extend one aesthetic direction across several related pages while preserving consistency and introducing deliberate variation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single-page PNG poster about [topic]. Use [preferred colors], minimal text, and a clear visual hierarchy.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused static design from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Translate a concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a visual philosophy for [concept], then express it as a PDF artwork. Include a subtle reference to [reference].
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants a concept translated into an original visual language.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an existing direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create artwork from [brief] using [movement or mood]. Prioritize precise spacing, integrated typography, and a limited palette. Complete a careful refinement pass.
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced designer needs stronger craft and consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Build a coordinated series
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] PDF pages for [project]. Use one visual philosophy, distinct compositions, subtle recurring references, and consistent typography across the series.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creative lead needs an advanced multi-page visual system.

output_examples.input: Create a poster about urban memory using red, black, and off-white.
output_examples.output: A single-page PNG with layered geometric marks, restrained labels, strong margins, and a concise design philosophy.

output_examples.input: Design quiet artwork for a ceramics studio with minimal text.
output_examples.output: A balanced PDF using generous negative space, subtle texture, refined typography, and a limited natural palette.

output_examples.input: Create three related pages about changing city rhythms.
output_examples.output: A coordinated PDF series with recurring visual references, distinct page compositions, and consistent typography.

best_practices: Provide the subject, intended audience, output format, page count, and any required text.
Describe preferred colors, mood, and references without asking to copy a living artist.
Review readability, margins, overlap, and font licensing before using the final artwork.
anti_patterns: Do not request dense reports, long paragraphs, or document layouts that conflict with the visual-first approach.
Do not ask for direct imitation of an artist or copyrighted artwork.
Do not leave essential text, dimensions, or output format unspecified when they affect delivery.

faq.question: Which output formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It produces PNG or PDF artwork and a Markdown file describing the visual philosophy.

faq.question: Does the skill create a design concept first?
faq.answer: Yes. It develops a concise visual philosophy before translating that direction into artwork.

faq.question: Can it create multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes. Request a page count to receive coordinated pages with consistent direction and distinct compositions.

faq.question: Can I provide custom fonts?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide licensed font files or approved sources. External downloads should use trusted sources and integrity checks.

faq.question: Can it copy a specific artist's style?
faq.answer: No. Request original work using general visual qualities, movements, materials, or moods instead.

faq.question: What should I include in my request?
faq.answer: Include the subject, audience, format, page count, required text, colors, mood, and any subtle reference.
